name: Reinforced Mop Bucket
description: A sturdy metal bucket that can double as a surprisingly effective shield

interactions.examine: This reinforced metal bucket has been with you since your first day at the Sanitation Bureau. It's dented from years of use but still sturdy. Someone (probably you during a slow shift) has engraved 'Bucket of Justice' on the side. The metal is thick enough to stop most attacks, and the handle makes it easy to wield defensively.
interactions.take: You grab the bucket by its sturdy handle. It's heavier than a normal bucket, reinforced specifically for hazardous cleaning duty. It also makes a satisfying 'clang' sound when you tap it.
interactions.use: You hold the bucket in front of you defensively. Its curved surface is perfect for deflecting attacks. You feel safer already, in a 'hiding behind a bucket' kind of way.
interactions.equip: You slip your arm through the bucket's handle, wielding it like a shield. Knights have their coat of arms; you have your bucket of justice.
